messages:
Aisha: Quick sync — vendor just pushed H200 availability by ~3 weeks. This touches our marketplace wave and joint SI announcements. Can we map impact?
Carl: Ugh. Which wave was H200 pinned to?
Aisha: Wave B (target 2026-06-01). If H200 slips, do we delay Wave B or swap in H100/H100x variant?
Jonas: Partner said H100 inventory is fine but H100x (cert build) still TODO. They can frontload some H100 units for customers on Dedicated.
Mei: Lab note: MI300 images are flaky with ROCm 5.6. We saw kernel oops on long-running jobs. Not ready for mass certing yet.
Priya: Product: customers on RG/Marketplace expect GA by early June. Sales already pre-announced to a few SIs. Delaying hurts trust.
Carl: Tradeoff — ship marketplace listing with a note: "platform supports H100, MI300, Gaudi, H200 pending availability" and gate H200 SKU until cert.
Jonas: That works if partners agree to embargo stagger. We need explicit embargo windows for press + SI playbooks.
Aisha: We should propose a staggered announcement: Wave A (H100 + Gaudi) go-live 2026-05-25, Wave B (H200 + MI300) soft-gated, Wave C (B200/other) later. Keep Wave B labeled "pending capacity".
Priya: +1. Also add automatic fallback in product docs: if H200 not available, route to H100x or quantized MI300 variant. Clear messaging avoids support churn.
Mei: Technical blocker: MI300 driver (ROCm) regression blocks long prompt state. Patch ETA from vendor ~5 days. If patch delayed, we should not promote MI300 in Wave B.
Jonas: I'll escalate with vendor and ask for a firm ship date. Also pushing H200 schedule with their supply PM.
announce-bot: Reminder — embargo policy: any joint press needs 72h lead and signed partner PR approvals.
Aisha: Good call. We can't promise press slots until both partner and infra ok. Keep comms internal for now.
Carl: Ops note — we can create a canary pool of 8 H100 GPUs and 4 Gaudi nodes for Wave A testing. If Wave B goes green, flip traffic.
Mei: Canary image build script (internal):
```
# build lab image
make image TARGET=mi300 ROCM=5.6
# run stress for 6h
./ci/run-stress.sh --duration 6h --model gpt-2
```
Current run failed at 2h with kernel stack trace, attaching logs to the ticket.
Priya: Can we publish a tentative customer-facing timeline? Something like: "Marketplace: H100 & Gaudi launching late May; H200 & MI300 rolling availability subject to partner timelines." Keep language conservative.
Aisha: Draft language looks safe. Jonas, please confirm partner OK with staggered embargo and that SI docs can be handed to certed integrators only.
Jonas: On it. I'll ping vendor PMs and post updates here by EOD.
Carl: One more thing — marketplace SKU naming must include "(beta)" for MI300 until our e2e tests pass. Ops needs that before we flip listing.
Mei: Agreed. We'll add automated health checks to block promotion.
Priya: Sales ask — can we give SIs a preview window (alpha access) to start integrations? Maybe a limited seat program.
Aisha: Yes, limited alpha for select SIs with NDA + embargo. We should log participants.
Jonas: I'll coordinate SI list. Please add the names to the alpha invite doc: https://redwood-internal/alpha-invite (internal).
deploy-bot: /create-release canary-waveA --env=staging --notify=@eng-oncall
Carl: I'll run the canary deploy tomorrow 09:00 PT.
Aisha: Actions: Jonas escalate vendor dates; Mei continue MI300 repro + logs; Carl prep canary pool; Priya draft customer messaging and alpha invite; I'll coordinate embargo signoffs. Update here when you have confirmations. :thumbsup:
Mei: Uploaded kernel log to ticket #HW-842, linking to thread.
Jonas: Vendor responded — tentative H200 ETA now 2026-06-15. Will try to accelerate.
Priya: Marking marketing calendar tentatively: public blog 2026-05-26 for Wave A, partner announcement deferred until Wave B confirmation.
Aisha: OK. If vendor accelerates, we can move Wave B up; otherwise we ship Wave A and call out rolling availability. Closing for now, will reopen if dates change.
Carl: Thanks all.
Priya: TY!
announce-bot: Thread archived by Aisha"
